doc.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Opening and arrival in Utica
summary: Rowe opens the second filmed session at Hamilton and welcomes Person, who is playing Utica the next night.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today at the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and it’s a great pleasure for me to have a second chance to talk to tenor saxophonist and band leader Houston Person.
Thank you, I’m glad to be here.
Making a — it’s fortunate for Utica jazz lovers that you’re appearing in Utica. We don’t get men of your stature that often up here, and so we’ll be looking forward to tomorrow night.
Oh I’m looking forward to it too. I’ve never been to Utica.
Well it had its day as a jazz center for a while. We do our best up here. But you’re a guy who’s had 75 albums at last count.
